utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can sort through the donations today. That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be great, Uli—thank you. Leo’s sending me the remaining tasks, and Sam should be bringing over the screws, duct tape, and hand tools soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good, I’ll get started on sorting right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll bring the screwdriver set, some zip ties, and a flashlight. Cleo can help spot anything else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Leo — that covers a lot. I’ll bring the sign-up sheet over and walk Bo through the first few sign-ups, and we’ll meet Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help with the first few tasks. Ira’s already been spreading the word all day, and Gus has the missing tools covered.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’ll check the school calendar and get back to you with the time and place for the repair drive. I’ll also help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the time and place when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring the tools for the repair drive. If you need, Rey can help with the tools too and cover a volunteer shift.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Gus. I’m keeping an eye on the supplies, and Noah will let me know what we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—just let me know what’s still missing, and I can help fill the gaps. I’ll bring the tools and keep Rey in mind for a shift.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll keep track of the volunteers and tools. Just let me know the time and place once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Eli — I’ll round up a few volunteers and bring my spare tools, then send you the time and place once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Mara. I’ll wait for the time and place, and I’ll keep track of the volunteers and tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Gus said he can bring a few tools, and Cleo can help gather what’s needed. Dane can help spread the word, too, and Ira’s already been telling folks while out on errands today.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot—can Gus bring the missing tools on time for me? And if Rey can keep the drop-off list updated, that would make this much easier to track.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think Gus can get the missing tools there on time for you. I’ll keep an eye out for Rey and ask about the drop-off list, too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — please put Sam on the list, and Uli can help sort donations too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ve added Sam and Uli to the list. I’m keeping track of who’s coming, so send me any more names as you get them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll send along anyone else who signs up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ll check what the repair drive still needs and let Cleo know. Maybe there are a few things left for Nell to help with too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — please let me know what’s still needed once you’ve checked. I’ll wait for the date to be confirmed before I update Mina, Bo, and Uli.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I’ll take a look and tell Cleo what’s missing. I’ll let you know once I’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort the deliveries and keep the drop-off list updated. And if you need a hand, I can take a volunteer shift too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That would be a huge help, Rey — thank you. I’m collecting spare screws, duct tape, and any hand tools folks can lend, and if we come up short, Vik can ask around for extras.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll keep the drop-off list current and take a volunteer shift when you need me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll stop by the repair drive later and see what they’re short on. If they need anything, I can ask around for tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — that’d really help. If you see what’s still short, let us know and we’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll check what’s still short later and pass it along. If they need anything specific, I’ll ask around for tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I’m still trying to line up a few more folks for the repair drive. If you hear of anyone else who needs a fix, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and send anyone who needs a fix your way. Vik said he might stop by later today too, so I’ll point him over if he comes by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, thanks. I appreciate you keeping an eye out, and I’ll be ready if Vik shows up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m going to ask Hana about the date and let you know. I’m also still asking around to see who’s organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — please let me know when you hear back from Hana. I’ll keep sorting the flyers here.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll ask Hana and pass it along as soon as I hear. Thanks for keeping the flyers sorted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Ira’s still lining up a few more folks for the repair drive, and Vik said he’ll stop by later to see what they need. I can pass along any gaps once we know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay—just to confirm, Sam’s helping too, right? And Leo’s still bringing the screwdriver set, zip ties, and flashlight?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, that’s right — Sam’s helping, and Leo’s still bringing the screwdriver set, zip ties, and flashlight. I’ll keep an ear out for anything else they’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a volunteer shift and help sort the deliveries, and I’ll keep the drop-off list updated too. Gus can bring the tools, so that should help us stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — that helps. Please keep me posted on the drop-off list, and I’m glad Gus can get the tools there on time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do, Pia — I’ll keep the drop-off list updated and let you know if anything changes. We should be in good shape with Gus handling the tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll gather the spare screws, duct tape, and any hand tools folks can lend. Vik can stop by later, and I’ll keep an eye out for Leo’s message too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can help with the first few tasks, and Gus can bring the missing tools if we still need them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, that should cover the start of it. I’ll keep collecting the extras and let everyone know as things come in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m asking around to see who’s organizing it, and Sam’s helping too. Faye said she’ll get back with the time and place for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’m keeping track of the supplies on my end, and Sam’s list should help a lot. Once Noah lets me know what’s missing, I’ll gather whatever we still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I can help sort tools or hand out flyers once the details are set. I’ll keep asking around so I can find out who’s coordinating it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve been spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll keep sharing it around the neighborhood. If you’re coming, Opal’s keeping track, so let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll help sort donations or carry a few things when I can. Leo’s supposed to send me the remaining details, and Sam should be bringing the screws, duct tape, and hand tools soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Oren — thanks for pitching in. Once Leo sends the details, just pass them along and I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll add Sam to the list for the repair drive. I’m also keeping track of who’s coming, so let me know if anyone else gets lined up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I’ll check the school calendar and get back to you with the time and place. I’ll also help spread the word once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Faye — once you have the time and place, send it my way and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll swing by a bit later and see what’s still needed. If I can, I’ll bring something useful too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Dane. I’ll check what tools or supplies the repair drive still needs and let Jules and Cleo know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Noah. I’ll check in later and bring whatever I can to help fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help sort the donations for the repair drive. Just let me know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, the repair drive is later, so I’ll stop by then. If you’re coming, I can also check whether we’re short on any tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. If you need me, I’ll be there to sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring the tools and help get any missing ones there on time. Rey can also cover a volunteer shift if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great, Gus — thank you. I’m still trying to line up a few more folks while I’m out running errands, so this really helps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help, Ira — just let me know what’s still missing and I’ll do my best to round it up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll bring my screwdriver set, zip ties, and flashlight. Thanks, Mara; with Sam helping and Cleo on supplies, we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks Leo — I’ll round up a few volunteers and bring my spare tools. Once you message Oren, Dane can catch up and pitch in where needed too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll message Oren now so Dane can jump in too. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: Noah checks what’s still needed, and we’ll ask Cleo and Rey to cover supplies, tools, and a volunteer shift. Once we have a start time, we can line everyone up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — Cleo can help gather what’s needed, and Gus can bring a few tools too. I’ll keep spreading the word with the folks I see today.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — then we just need Noah’s list and a clear start time, and we can fill the last volunteer spots. I’ll keep things orderly from there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll bring the sign-up sheet over and walk Bo through the first few sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — thanks. I’ll keep sorting flyers with Nell, and if you need me to check anything else just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be lovely, Mina — thanks for helping with the flyers. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.
